pointPair.help: Where the left and the right fighter (or platform) stand, in stage pixels.

frameTime.help: Milliseconds per frame: one number for every frame, or one number per frame (10 to 10000; default 120).

soundByFrame.help: A sound that plays when a frame begins: the frame number (from 0), then a sound id of data/audio.json.

sideSheets.help: The fighter of a map side (by side id) draws from another sheet with the same cell size and layout.

anim.help: One animation: frames of one sheet (a null in the file means none).

sheet.help: The sheet every frame is in; its cell size is the frame size.

frames.help: The cells [column, row] shown one after the other (1 to 512; a cell may repeat).

loop.help: Plays again and again (default: yes for stand and standRanged, no for the others).

hit.help: The frame where the blow lands (default: the last frame).

spawn.help: The frame a projectile or effect appears on (default: the hit frame).

animHold.help: One animation; it may wait on a pose until the result is known (a null in the file means none).

holdFrame.help: Waits on this frame for the result (on or after the hit frame of a strike).

animDodge.help: A dodge: it may start late and wait on a pose (a null in the file means none).

holdFrame.help: Waits on this frame (not before startFrame).

startFrame.help: The frames before this one are the brace before the blow.

startDelayMs.help: Moves the start of the dodge from the miss by this long (needs startFrame or holdFrame).

battleSet.help: The animations of one kind of fighter.

faces.help: Which way the art looks; the other side is drawn turned round.

mirror.help: The right-hand fighter is the art turned round; off: never turned.

anchor.help: The foot point [x, y] in a frame, pixels from its top left (default: bottom middle).

sides.help: Another sheet for the fighters of a side: every animation without its own sides entry uses it.

animations.help: The animations by name; stand is needed, all others are optional.

crit.help: A critical strike in melee (falls back to attack).

ranged.help: A strike from a distance (falls back to attack).

critRanged.help: A critical strike from a distance (falls back to crit).

cast.help: Casting, for a weapon with an effect or a staff (falls back to attack).

miss.help: A strike that misses (falls back to attack).

dodge.help: The struck fighter avoids the blow.

dodgeRanged.help: Avoiding a blow from a distance (falls back to dodge).

standRanged.help: Standing while the fight is ranged (falls back to stand). Loops by default.

effectFrame.help: A frame of an effect: a cell of the effect's sheet, or a cell of another sheet with the same cell size.

effectIds.help: One effect of the library, or several (up to 8).

rangeStep.help: From this fight distance on: the effect starts later, or a flight stops short (one of the two is needed).

from.help: The fight distance in squares the step starts at (each used once).

delayMs.help: Milliseconds the whole effect starts later.

endOffset.help: A travel effect stops this many pixels short of the target (negative: flies past).

hideStep.help: Hides the backdrop and / or the platforms for a while.

what.help: What is hidden (each at most once).

color.help: The colour shown in its place, such as #102030.

atRangeFixed.help: Not delayed by the effect's atRange.

fadeStep.help: A colour laid over the scene: in over ms, held, then out over ms.

ms.help: The time to fade in, and again to fade out.

alpha.help: How opaque it gets at its peak (above 0, at most 1).

holdMs.help: How long it stays at its peak.

over.help: Over everything (the fighters too) or the backdrop only.

atRangeFixed.help: Not delayed by the effect's atRange.

flashStep.help: A flash of colour over the stage.

atRangeFixed.help: Not delayed by the effect's atRange.
Not delayed by the effect's atRange.

effect.help: A weapon's or weapon group's effect, a library effect (with an id) used in lists, or an assignment of library effects.

id.help: Library name (letters, digits, _ and -): lets other entries use this effect in their effects lists.

weapon.help: The weapon (or staff item) it belongs to (or use group; one of the two, unless it has an id only).

group.help: The weapon group it belongs to.

effects.help: Plays these library effects (an entry with a weapon or group, without pictures of its own).

byType.help: Other library effects when this unit type strikes.

mode.help: target: appears on the foe. travel: flies from the striker.

travelMs.help: Flight time of a travel effect.

speed.help: Travel only, instead of travelMs: stage pixels per second (needs a fixed stage).

anchor.help: The point [x, y] of a frame that sits on the path or target (default: its middle).

frames.help: The frames, one after the other (1 to 512).

sounds.help: Sounds by the milliseconds after the effect starts (0 to 60000), then a sound id of data/audio.json.

hitAtMs.help: The effect starts this long before the hit lands (not for travel).

fromHitFrame.help: Not for travel: the effect starts at the striker's hit frame and the hit lands hitAtMs after it.

hitAfterMs.help: Travel only: the hit lands this long after the shot leaves, even before it arrives.

layer.help: In front of the fighters, behind them, or over the whole stage (screen).

order.help: Screen layers only: where it sits in the drawing order.

mirror.help: Screen layers only: turned round with the striker.

at.help: Appears on the foe or on the striker (not for travel or screen).

returns.help: Travel only: flies back to the striker.

lingerMs.help: Travel only: stays at the target this long after arriving.

endOffset.help: Travel only: stops this many pixels short of the target (negative: flies past).

blend.help: add: the pixels brighten what is under them.

panAtMs.help: A panning stage band: the camera moves to the struck fighter this long after the effect starts.

atRange.help: Delays or shortened flights by fight distance (1 to 16 steps, each from used once).

atRangeFixed.help: Not delayed by distance (not with its own atRange).

hide.help: Hides the backdrop and / or platforms for a while (up to 32).

fade.help: Colour fades over the scene (up to 32).

assignRule.help: Which set a fighter uses: the most specific rule that fits wins (needs at least one of type, character, group, weapon, side).

group.help: Group of the weapon struck with (not together with weapon).

weapon.help: That very weapon (not together with group).

backdrop.help: A picture: one cell of a sheet, scaled up by a whole number to cover the screen.

platform.help: The ground a fighter stands on: a cell, with optional pictures for a far fight and for the right-hand fighter.

cell.help: The cell (the left-hand fighter's; the right one is it turned round unless right is given).

far.help: Cell for a fight at a distance.

right.help: The right-hand fighter's own cell (fixed stage).

farRight.help: The right-hand fighter's own far cell (needs far).

stageBand.help: A layout for fights from this distance on.

from.help: The fight distance in squares the band starts at (1 is the close layout, feet; each used once).

feet.help: Where the fighters stand (a panning band may use x up to 8191).

view.help: both: both fighters in one picture. each: one fighter at a time, with a pan.

pan.help: How the camera moves between the fighters.

panMs.help: Milliseconds the camera takes (0: it cuts).

leftView.help: The stage x of the picture's left edge while on the left fighter (the fighter must be inside).

rightView.help: The same for the right fighter.

backdrop.help: fixed: the picture stays put. scroll: it moves with the camera and repeats sideways.

startMs.help: The pan starts this long after the strike starts (default: timed to arrive at the hit).

stage.help: A fixed stage: the picture size, where the fighters and platforms stand, and how the background is cropped.

feet.help: Where the fighters' feet are (close fight).

feetFar.help: Their feet in a fight at a distance.

platformFar.help: The platforms in a fight at a distance (needs platform).

align.help: Which part of the background is kept when it is cropped.

fit.help: cover: fills the stage (cropped). contain: shown whole.

rangeLine.help: Draw a line showing the fight distance.

ranges.help: Layouts by fight distance (1 to 16 bands).

battle.help: The battle scene's art (docs/BATTLE_SCENE.md): fighter animation sets, weapon effects, who uses which set, backgrounds, platforms, a fixed stage.

sets.help: Animation sets by name; a set needs a stand animation.

effects.help: Weapon effects and the library effects they use.

terrainBackground.help: The background to use for each terrain.

defaultBackground.help: The background when the terrain has none.

terrainPlatform.help: The platform to use for each terrain.

defaultPlatform.help: The platform when the terrain has none.

scene.help: How long a held pose waits after the result.

resultHoldMs.help: The result is over this long after the hit or miss.

resultHoldAgainMs.help: Added when the same fighter strikes again next.
